evidence_requirements.description: Exactly 500 registered elastic-structure model cells (125 structures by four models) with immutable receipts, no retries, no imputation, and a0/C11/C12/C44 observables.
At least 16 distinct non-tied applied structures per scorable class-property under the prospectively registered class grouping rule.
Separate hull-width and sharp-license records for class, chemistry, structure prototype, composition-space neighbourhood, and the immutable v2 exact tuple; no cross-rule substitution.

exclusions.rationale: Preregistered excluded_unavailable: no reproducible gated UMA checkpoint was available at lock time.
exclusions.subject: uma-family

exclusions.rationale: Round 5 measures elastic structures only; LiTraj/CI-NEB paths and barrier observables are a different campaign and cannot enter this panel.
exclusions.subject: litraj-neb-paths

exclusions.rationale: The legacy Round-4 jobs have drifted to mutable Z1 images and retries; Round 5 requires dedicated digest-pinned jobs with maxRetries zero.
exclusions.subject: legacy-round4-cloud-run-jobs

exclusions.rationale: Undefined or operator-supplied chemistry and composition-space-neighbourhood labels are forbidden; only the v3 hash-locked derivation is admissible.
exclusions.subject: unversioned-grouping-labels

frozen_hypotheses.statement: Under the unchanged direction gate and machine-checked sharp license, class-grouped correction wins on at least three of four powered confirmatory properties in each registered material class.

Prospectively derived chemistry, structure-prototype, and composition-space-neighbourhood reference sets are compared separately with class reference sets for hull width and sharp-license admissibility; only the 18 registered width contrasts are inferential secondary claims.
